from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json
root=Path.cwd(); parent=root/"reports/research/510300_official_joint_cause_full_original_population_v1"
e59=json.loads((parent/"result.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
existing=json.loads((parent/"全部5原官方解释_作用对象与共同限定.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
known={x["stat_month"] for x in existing}
all_same=e59["all_same_production_49_8_months"]; missing=sorted(set(all_same)-known)
assert all_same==["2022-07","2022-08","2023-01","2024-02","2024-08","2025-01","2025-04"]
assert missing==["2022-07","2022-08","2023-01","2025-01"]
out=root/"reports/research/510300_equal_production_all_original_month_cause_sources_v1"
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
p={
 "study_id":"510300_EQUAL_PRODUCTION_ALL_ORIGINAL_MONTH_CAUSE_SOURCES_V1","experiment_id":"E60","registered_at":stamp,
 "status":"REGISTERED_ALL_7_ORIGINAL_EQUAL_VALUE_MONTHS_4_MISSING_OFFICIAL_CAUSE_SOURCES_BEFORE_SEARCH",

 "new_evidence_changes_next_action":"E59完整86月母集实际同49.8有7个月而非两个或三个；先核齐这7个同值原月份的共同原因，可回答具体因子含义问题。全原1711原因面板仍不完整，不先采81月或建模。",
 "question":"在完整原月份所有生产49.8的7个月中，官方是否给出不同或并存的需求/生产/公共事件理由，其作用对象和原公开钟是什么。",

 "network_budget":{"official_search_queries_max":4,"original_stats_gov_cn_GETs_max":4,"retries":0,"redirects":0,"authenticated_calls":0},
 "source_url_selection":"只选这四检索实际返回的官方同月解读原URL；新URL必须在GET前保存实际选择，不拼模板/猜ID或读取项目凭据；缺对象、非200或身份不符保持UNKNOWN，不延长路线。",
 "population_fidelity":"所有7原月份完整保留，目标由完整原同值母集确定，不读股市收益选样、不只取解释鲜明或盈利月份；本问题由旧E52后验同值失败产生，属于开发解释而非独立检验。",
 "cause_contract":"原整体PMI共同解释、生产单项解释、价格/预期/行业对象及同期背景分别保存；多因并存，未提及不等于0。官方话语不等于单变量股票因果权重或完整市场预期。",
 "clock":"保存原显示/元数据时刻、URL归档日、实际收件。日内发布未知不可从成文日/URL填时间；首次版本未认证保留UNKNOWN。原当前月第一决定、之后各原成员全部保留，不移动决定钟。",
 "old_routes_preserved":"E38三月采购来源问题已结束，不重发其原三GET；E54旧两源直接复用。E51/E56固定模型拒绝不变，E33/E58金额访问无新变化。",
 "model_budget":0,"new_return_label_budget":0,"account_budget":0,"source_code_edit_budget":0,
 "full_original_cause_model_admission":"NOT_ESTABLISHED","net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,
 "current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False
}
(out/"protocol.json").write_text(json.dumps(p,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
(parent/"下一来源问题基于完整同值母集事实更新.json").write_text(json.dumps({"at":stamp,"prior_next_missing_earliest_months":"2018-11/12原全来源下一设想保留","actual_new_same_value_population_count":7,"known_same_value_originals":3,"missing_same_value_originals":missing,"actual_next_registered_protocol":str(out.relative_to(root)/"protocol.json"),"change_before_new_search_or_return_reads":True,"financial_gate_unchanged":True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"protocol":str(out/"protocol.json"),"all_equal":all_same,"new_official_queries":p["search_queries"],"new_source_GET_budget":4},ensure_ascii=False))
